reviews.review_description: The sales team was very good and helpful. Team members for installation was very good and fast.
This is oure second solar system with More Green Energy. We are very happy withAlex sale person and John installation services.

Had a pleasant experience with More Green team. Even though my choice of inverter product became unavailable close to installation date, it was handled professionally by the team- and we discussed alternative brand.

My experience with this company has been very disappointing. Contracted and paid deposit 3/8/2022 for 6.6kw system and advised installation would happen within 2 weeks.  Every interaction since deposit was paid has been instigated by me. I contacted them on 3/8 and was finally advised they could not install contracted system and offered a smaller system. This was unacceptable and I asked for a refund of my deposit as they could not meet the terms of the contract. I have contacted them repeatedly, they promise to follow up and return call (never do) they give time frame for deposit of refund 10 days, 72 hours etc etc none of which have been met. Deposit still outstanding. Have had to start proceedings with NSW Fair Trading.  They offer very competitive prices however check out the consumer feedback on independent web sites before making your decision to engage this company.
Polite, Understood my needs, Installed within a week and good operators. They also organised the grid connection. All done within a matter of weeks
Quotes provided inline with my requirements. Provided us with suitable options and a range of systems. Customer service was very good from quote to installation.

It was easy, smooth. Afnan was point of contact from More Green energy. Very helpful and forthcoming.Installation was finished in less than 3 hours. They organized grid connection as well after the install - wrote to my electric provider with necessary paperwork.Cost wise - value for money. Will recommend them.

Afnan the sales executive help me to choose the correct panel and inverter and above all correct size of solar system for my home. Discussed all the option i can go through. Then customised an amazing package 7.88kw system with  Jinko 415 w 19 panels panels with mid range best inverter 6 kw Goodwe.Also sorted my finance in a day. And installed the system with in a week after i accepted the quotation.Still following up the performance of my system.For pricing to installation Afnan has gone his above and beyond. Highly recommend.

Very goodVery goodVery goodExcellent service from More Green Energy. After installation, customer service are more important which More Green Energy doing very well for me well satisfactions all time.
Nice easy process, very professional arrived on time and friendly sales staff

Thanks very much to Alex Williamson for the great service .kept in constant touch with us throughout the whole process and made it a very easy and simple process .Also thanks to Aakash and his team for friendly efficient professional  installation of our system. in half a day they had completed the job and the system was up and running .I would highly recommend more green energy to anyone looking at solar

I would to thank More Green Energy specially The senior solar consultant Afnan is  prefect he gave me good advice good quote amazing Afnan, I put my trust in him and he was in a position of trust. The installation was tidy and good job I would thank  all the installers they did great job.

Signed up and payed deposit, looking forward to getting installation at the end of the month. This all happened 02/10/2021.Everything about this company is non existent except for the deposit. I have made many calls to this MOREGREEN company, sometimes they would answer, if they answer they will get back to you., but don't. Hey MOREGREEN I'm still waiting for a call back. What a scam. But hey I'm not going to drop this. I will keep RINGING & RINGING & RINGING.Why are these people still operating.  My experience for installation is nnon existent I'm still waiting.I wish I found this site sooner.

I ah still waiting for them to return my call I have been waiting 3 month to find out what is wrong with our solar panels there is always an issue with getting through on the telephone - no one answers or when you get through they hang up on you,  sending emails and getting a response is a joke, if you try and call they are unreachable and when they did call back you get nowhere. Terrible company do not purchase from them.Only thing I can now do is try consumer affairs.

They were excellent in getting back to me re the sales and was always helpful and friendly.The installation seemed to go well, though they had said they where installing a bonus three panels and this didn't happen. It was to be a 10.4KW system but they installed 9.4KW . Probably sensible given what happened next.I had the solar switch before the inverter catch fire the first really hot day in October, the fire brigade come as I couldn't stop the fire, in the end they had to close off all the switches on the roof to stop the re-ignition. The Firemen said that they there have been a number of similar situations happening across Australia and would be reporting this incident to the gov regulators. I hear that this situation is still happening though have no idea if it isolated to a particular product or service. It is highly dangerous and some people who have lost their homes due to this situation, every incident like it has this potential.They took nearly a month to fix the switch - due to weather forecast for rain - though we hardly had any rain for at least half the time and then they came on a day that it was raining. They staff are friendly and polite even when I was rather angry with them. There where two switches put in to replace the one in hope that this would divert the experienced disaster, however the system has only worked for two half days since September. It is tripping the main safety switch. I could go on but I think you get the idea. I am not sure if they are understaffed, or they are over worked but I find that there is no urgency and very little action to follow up on there given apology, even though they do indeed continue to be very polite with me.I really hate having to give such reviews and held off for a long time in submitting one, but I have thought that the whole issue was so dangerous that I should be letting people know to be aware of no matter which company you choose. I have included my other issues due to my frustration. I admit I have not been attention to detail and have placed a lot of trust in the installers, please do not do this for any company, you should always be diligent and also keep a close eye on any relatively new installation of an electrical item.It is a Goodwe inverter that is installed (this was not what caused the fire, but is what has now failed), I note there are some negative review in the same time period as my issue in relation to this inverter.

I resently had solar installed by More Green Solar after long time of searching online ,talking to many installers and getting few quotes. I found that More Green is the best. Great value for money and fantastic service. The sale & admin guy Alex is excellent ,very pleasant,patience and helpful. The installation team had done a beautiful job. They arrived on time, took extra care around the property and didn't break any tiles.I am very happy that I'd chosen the right installer and highly recommend It.

I have to say the whole process was great, no complaints at all. I don't know much about solar systems at all but my brother-in-law helped us out and recommended More Green Energy. He loves the product and the savings he has made and contacted Alex from More Green Energy for us. Once initial communication was made then Alex called me and we went from there. He explained things, communicated clearly and never got frustrated with my questions.  He set out a clear quote with pics of the job that would be done.  The sales process was easy.  The job was only delayed by 1 week due to weather but then happened when they said.  Mark and his team came out to install the panels.  They were all very polite to my mother, they arrived when they said they would and got the job complete in the time they said they would.  Follow up phone calls were received immediately that night from John who guided us to connect the system to our modem, etc.  John was very patient through this process as I am not very IT savvy at all.  All in all the entire process was a 5-star job!! Thanks More Green Energy!!

We used this company on our first installation and had some issues ,but with the second install they raised there game and did a very good job .For your own information of the 3 companies you supplied only two gave us quotes and they were both more than three times the price of the company we used .The quotes they suppled would have take about twelve years to recover our costs . Way to long

We paid $3200 for a 6.6 kw system from More Green Energy last April. The panels were all facing north, so now we miss generating power after 3.30pm (in WA) The installer placed a panel over a bathroom vent and crushed it as well.More Green Energy refused to talk or rectify the problem.Now we have a failed Growatt inverter (verified by an independent electrician) and More Green Energy have once again failed to warrant their product. Consumer affairs are now our only chance of getting our money back as I have contacted them and their installer who refuse ti reply.DO NOT DEAL WITH MORE GREEN ENERGY!
Monty, John & Alex were great and so was Afnan. Vert good and clear presentation on competitive offer. Response is quick and efficient. Committed to task. Highly recommended for solar.

Very seamless process from the initial interaction of quotation to sales and to the installation, Special thanks to Mr Afnan for explaining me the right Solar product. Mr Afnan was very knowledgeable and friendly. The installation guys were quick and efficient, communicated well. I was contacted to ensure the installation process went smoothly.
This experience has been amazing! Nathan Jones (0422627664) was wonderful to deal with & the boys who fitted them were perfect! I will recommend them to everyone!

The supply and installation of our solar system was professional, prompt, courteous and efficient.After the installation, connection to the grid was seamless .The overall experience with Moregreen Energy has been very satisfactory from the quotation process to commissioning .Great return on investment.

- The salesman Nathan Jones went out of his way to give me exactly what I wanted at an attractive price.- The installer, Pierre and Peter, went beyond assigned work to move (and let me keep) two older panels to be used for garden illumination for no extra cost. Very polite, tidy and punctual. Delightful people.- Haven't had much use for customer service, but John Harris was very obliging and helpful with the setting up of the wifi monitoring software.

The effort at customer service in securing the best product at the best possible price through to the quality and care in installation through to the after installation support - has all been a score of 11 out of 10!.....just a fantastic experience leaving me totally satisfied with the money invested into the system as well as the Business providing the system!Thank you to all the team lead by Alex - courteous/ knowledgeable/ professional in every way!
More green  energy  Girraween team is fabulous. They helped us alot. Reasonable quotation and great work. Thanks
Installed the product about 7 months ago.  Excellent product and service.I have a follow up technical question recently and it was addressed in a timely and professional manner.Will highly recommend.
Salesman was nice and supportiveInstallation team did job well efficientlySupport team done the good job to have the meter issue resolved after liaising with Enphase support.Highly recommended..

They were sweet and sugary till I paid the money. They made false promises. They offered me 6 months interest and fee free payment arrangements. They promised to refund even if the credit card company charges any fee. But when the 6 month period was over the credit card company charged $100 and refused to enter into any discussion. When I contacted More Green Energy, initially I was told that I will get a refund but the money was never refunded. Now they are not responding to my phone calls. I tried contacting online but still no response. They purposely avoiding my phone calls. Such a poor customer service.I wonder how this company got the licence to operate in Australia. I never faced with such poor customer service in Australia in my life time.One cannot contact anyone other than the sales. No one can reach  someone with responsibility to escalate any issue.During installation the contractor broke a roof tile and when it rained water entered the roof space and damaged an entire light fitting. When I contacted More green energy there was no help. Refuse to compensate for the damage.So, please avoid More Green Energy.I will not recommend More Green Energy to anyone.

Thank you Kim, John and Monty for your excellent customer service, installation and after service provided.Impressed with your prompt action and your follow up with with our minor Inverter issue which was satisfactorily resolved.Highly recommend More Green Energy for all your Solar needs.Kim, John and Monty are there to help !!!

Had Solar installed by More Green Energy 2 months ago for a very good price. Saving a lot of money so far and nil issues. Nil electric bills and now saving money on gas! Janet from sales was great and has a lot of info on quality and  price!The service team of John and Monty are terrific and always monitor your system and help solve any issues that arise straight away.
Easy to communicate with and installed well. Happy so far.
The whole process was simple, easy to understand, installation was efficient, installers were polite and organised.
I like to say thank you Alex to you and crew for great service and very prompt installation once again thank you
They were professional to deal with and gave us prompt service. I would give them a high recommendation. they always responded quickly to any of my queries.

Quoted and accepted agreement on 24th February, but not installed until 22nd April, originally quoted 3 weeks, disappointed on that side,  Nathan is a lovely man but not so good at customer curtesy and letting know what was happening, I had to contact him! When said I was cancelling got immediate installation in 2 days!
Explained the different options and quoted, Installed on the promised date & Fantastic after sales service by Peter, Monty & John

Installation took a little more time to organise than I expected  but understandable considering we are regional. The installers were very polite and efficient with putting up the new system and taking down the old one, and left my place spotless. System is working great. Altogether a good experience.
Very happy with Customer service of Afnan  Senior Solar Consultant More Green Energy
Reasonably priced compared to all market solar providers and great service already seeing results.

Dealing with Abby and her team made the sales process very easy and understandable, the came the installation side of the process and it went really well and the guys set everything up for me and made sure I had a full understanding of the equipment as well as the mobile monitoring system, they did the whole thing and made me a very happy customer, and if I rang customer service I was made very welcome and dealt with very professional.

I went onto a blog about these guys and was inundated with terrible customer experiences and terrible after sales. These guys lied to me and told me they were CEC accredited. You can look up CEC accredited companies on the CEC website, and More Green Energy are not. I will also suggest that most reviews online are actually done by affiliates of More Green Energy. I expect that they will post dodgy “good” reviews after this one. Read the good reviews and compare them with the bad to make your own mind up. It’s actually laughable how dodgy some of the good reviews are. Their website is not operational today and I was informed by WA Consumer Protection that they have received numerous complaints regarding this company. STAY AWAY. Yesterday  I was rung by them to tell me to cancel my productreview.com review of them. I don’t care if I lose my deposit, just don’t deal with them as they’re as dodgy as they come.

I had known about this solar company through my uncle and his friends, therefore my dad and I decided to install solar in order to reduce the cost of electricity. At the beginning, everything seemed to be fine until we received our first electricity bill, which I found out that we did not receive any credits for feed-in tariffs. This was when I was involved in such a lengthy process between the energy provider and solar company in order to investigate the problem. After Vector's electrician got involved (on 22/12/20), we figured out that the solar installer had incorrectly connected our solar to my neighbour's main switch, not ours (btw we live in a duplex).We would never imagine that we have had to go through too many problems and unprofessional practices from the staff of this company.An electrician contacted the installer who installed the panels on that day to inform the issue and he promised to come at 4pm on 22/12/20 (I had to take a day off to wait for him). We were literally waiting until 10ish and they did not message or call anything to say that he was not be able to come due to whatever reasons, not until I contacted them at 10ish and was told he would come the next day. I did call him a couple of times around 4pm, 6pm and 7ish to double check if he would turn up.Once they fixed up the issue, they reassured me to contact them, in order to negotiate the compensation. We need a compensation for a period of 4/7/20 to 23/12/20 for the loss of solar production, which appeared to be used by my neighbour. I had to constantly email and call them from 11/1/21 to 29/1/21 to urge them giving me an action plan for the problem that their installer had caused us. On 28/1/21, I emailed them to express my inconvenience and uncomfortable to keep chasing them up for update. I was aware that they were busy as well, so I stated in the email that I was willing to give them some more days until Friday 5/2/2021 for someone to contact me to discuss the action plan. Otherwise, I will take further action on my side.As what I expected, they have not got back to me, no emails, no phone call and for that reason, I had to escalate this issue to a third party-Fair Trading. I had submitted my complaint and awaiting for the results.Also, they did not measure the roof probably as they only did it online through (appear to me) taking photo from google earth. No inspection in prior the installation day. This resulted in the faulty number of panels needed for my roof, as originally they planned to install 18 panels.  Therefore, only 16/17 panels were installed and this caused an impact to the final payment. I had to ring up different people (the installer provided the contact) to negotiate the final payment! My friends had installed solar before and their companies always sent someone to inspect the roof before the installation. Once again, this was my fault for not doing more research about this but trusting them because they literally installed solar for my uncle earlier 2020!I would like to emphasie that I WILL NOT RECOMMEND THIS SERVICE TO ANYONE THAT I KNOW, as I do not want them to take even a small possibility to go through this mess and to deal with unprofessional staff.
They said 2 weeks but everything got done  within a week and very smooth.Afnan is your man for solar solutions.
Thanks for the service with in due time , The boys came quickly and install the inverter on the same day it arrived

I had solar system installed in October 2018.I had no major issues with quoting process and installation of the system.The Inverter failed in September 2019. Since we had 5 other people living with us at the time, and I was busy, I didn't contact More Green Energy until 6th of January 2020. They requested some information, which I provided immediately. After that, they just ignored me. Nothing was done until I complained to the Dept of Fair Trading.The Inverter was replaced in May. However, the system hardly worked. It produces about $5 of power per month. I contacted More Green Energy again. They requested some information, which I provided immediately. After that, they just ignored me again.I took them to NSW Civil and Administration Tribunal. A phone session was arranged for 29/10/20. More Green Energy didn't answer the phone. Another hearing was set for 27/1/21.More Green Energy then installed a Wifi for me to monitor daily production. Since they installed the Wifi, the system works much better. However, averages daily production is 17 kWh. They promised me 27kWh a day.I wrote to More Green Energy on 14/1/21 and told them that I am not happy with the system and never will be. I requested $400 for past losses due to the system either not working or not working properly and I will consider this case closed. They did reimburse me for $400 as requested.Just to reiterate the system doesn't work properly and More Green Energy service is almost non-existent.It is all good until something goes wrong.My advise is, don't deal with this company.BTW, I expect a number of 5 star rating reviews after I post this review.I have had solar installed to 2 properties in the last year with another company. The difference in service is amazing.

Great service & assistance so far. Only had installed today but they fitted in with me & all looks good so far. Cloudy day so yet to see full impact but helpful App helps you see exactly what you’re getting back power-wise from anywhere in the world.Nathan Jones was very helpful in organising the whole thing.Would recommend happily.

The customer support officer alex (afnan) looked after very well from booking to installation very well. Not pushing to buy. Offered me what i wanted and gave me better price. Very helpful.  The installation team was good. Came on time. Did a very professional installation. Explained all process and how to operate. They installed 17 panels instead of 18, due to lack of room discovered during physical inspection. Technician seems like in the field for many years and have good experience. Overall good company to get solar system

The company provided three quotes for various quality systems and were very happy to discuss different options. They were not pushy and listened to what I was looking for in a solar system.Installation was straight forward and the installers were professional. I expected installation to take a few weeks as we live in a regional area but to my surprise the system was installed four days after I signed the contract to purchase the solar system. The only concern I had was that there was no confirmation from the installation team that they were showing up. The sales rep informed me that the install would happen on a particular day and it did but I was not sure that it would happen until the team showed up mid afternoon on the stated day.Customer service was mostly great. The company initiated most contact at appropriate times either via a phone call or an email. The company organised everything and contacted our electricity provider to ensure a smart meter was fitted for connection to the grid. We were kept informed at each stage of the process except for the confirmation from the install team.

Customer service thusfar has been great. Afnan was very courteous and patient and helped us get a better deal. He was easy to contact and answered the myriad of questions we had before Installation as well as post Installation. Extremely impressed with the transparency and easy/open communication. They confirmed that they are organising with the energy provider to have my meter upgraded from old analogue to new smart meter now that the installation is completed, so one less thing for me to worry about!As for the system itself the wifi monitoring and battery compatability at such a low price point of 3200 after debate for 6.6kw panel/5kw inverter was impressive, I guess time will tell as to how it performs over its lifecycle.Installation in western Sydney was quick and efficient and the installers were respectful and happy to answer questions.

Having had Green Energy reccomended to me and was told to speak with Alex Williamson by a neighbour who had dealt with them.I rang and spoke to Alex, told him I was thinking about  a 6.6kw system. He looked at our roof, via the internet and explained what panels and the process required, through to installation, with an approximate installation date. He quoted me a firm price, no hidden costs. There was no pressure to buy, he wanted us to have all the facts before we took that step.  We did accept his quote. Later his installer, Pierre, messaged through an installation date, turned up with his team at 7am as arranged. This guy is so friendly, nothing bothers him. He knows his job, is really effecient,  you can ask him anything, he will stop and explain, as anyone of his team has. The installation was finished in no time. I cannot express how happy we are with the whole process. It was just seamless. People we dealt with were great. I don't generally give reviews but this time it would be wrong not to, they were that good.

We are very happy with the system we have got. It’s a 10.2 kW, Risen panels with a 10kW Fronius inverter. On good summer days we get 60+ kWh/day. The best so far was 72kWh just yesterday. During the winter of course lower, around 30kWh in average.My only whine is about the communication. Moregreen, you have to up your communication skills.
Very friendly and easy to understand. The installation was done exactly as scheduled. The customer Service was excellent. Thanks to Afnan.

Got quote on Thursday agreed price Thursday afternoon, signed contract Friday.Tuesday new westernpower meter installed for buy back to grid.Wednesday solar installed. Wednesday mid morning solar working app showing how much electricity generated 18.5Kwh on a sunny/cloudy day.$1.5 back into grid as of Wednesday afternoon.How good is this.So easy to work with good company.
Alex made the whole process from signup to switch on, flawless. Great service and great value for money.

Signed up with them last year in Victoria. Took initial deposit till that time everything was fine and was informed will get installation in 2 month time. Then communication stopped no response to emails and calls, they are not even approved solar retailer and give contract to someone else. After 6 months they informed that their contracted in Victoria had issues and will take bit more longer. Requested for cancellation and then they need more time. Then after 2 months they sent cancellation letter and informed will be refunded for initial money. That Never happened keep telling we have to refund a lot of people and will take time. Staff at company are completely rude and even disconnect call when asked about refund and no reply to emails at all. So completely waste of time and money.

We had an existing 3.5Kw system & saw the advertising for the 6.6Kw & thought with the addition of that system over a 12 month period our power bills would be close to nil over the year. The energy provider Essential energy would not approve the installation as the total inverter power would have been 8kw. Alex from More Green Energy knowing what we were trying to achieve advised us that they could provide a limiter of 5 Kw back to the grid which was acceptable to Essential Energy. Thus we use what ever power for the house first & then export the rest. eg on a sunny if we were producing 8Kw & were using the air conditioner which uses 2Kw / hour, we would be exporting 5 Kw & getting the rebate for that & only wasting 1 Kw ( maybe). I was happy with Alex & the install team who installed who install the system within 5 days of Essential energy approving the system.

Installation was not what I had agreed with. They have not still fixed my panels.Poor English, it was hard to communicate and all non professional workers. Once they get the money they forget about your problem.Not Happy at all with installation, customer service is absolutely non Australian standard. Very very unhappy with way I was spoken too. Very rude.They treat you as no-one after they get your money. NEVER GO WITH MORE GREEN ENERGY. BETTER PAY COUPLE OF THOUSAND MORE AND GET SOMEONE WHO YOU CAN TRUST.

Sales side was professional and patience to my enquires specifically by senior sales his name Afnan.Also the installation was very good by hard working Pierre team.The support for configuration with our WIFI was poor from the software team which normally take place by phone.

I have contacting with Alex for last 6 months. He is amazing very professional. Mainly for his friendly and easy going attitude made me to go with more green company..He is the big asset for this company.

When a final install date was agreed on the install team arrived on time and ready to start. They had the odd hurdle to jump but nothing seemed to be to hard for them. They finished in the dark as they were determined to complete the job. They never broke a tile and cleaned the site before they left. They advised me it would start up in the morning which it did and has been producing an average of 23 kw per day. The only issue was trying to get the wifi talking to my system which they are working on it. After two very heavy rain sessions a small water leak was noticed which the installers are looking at. They arranged for the meter changeover which has been done. More green energy were always easy to communicate with and I would recommend them before a lot of others offering solar systems.
Sales process is very easy,Polite,Customer service is very helpful.

We had Janet as our sales representative and she was extremely helpful and friendly. She talked through the options of panels, inverters and layouts; responded to my questions and feedback and that lead to us signing the quote.After paying the deposit, within two weeks we had booked in for the install. The installers did turn up later in the day than expected, but they were professional and friendly. Few hours later we had the panels and inverter setup and finished. Install was done neatly, they did leave some brick dust and cable mess around the inverter but they finished quite late in the day and for the price, you don't get perfection.Overall we are very happy with the price we got, the install and the service. We would definitely recommend Janet as our sales rep for others.

Great service, installation was quick and easy at an affordable price and happy with the layout of the solar panels. Mr Afnan from moregreen was very helpful, knowledgeable and friendly and was happy to answer all my questions and comments. Staff at moregreen were also friendly when communicating and assisting with the installation. Thank you to moregreen, Afnan and team including installation team for providing the best service.
Good Solar Installer And Battery Backup Is Really A Very Good And It's A Very Nice Digital Inverter

The installation crew turned up on time and asked me where I would like the inverter installed the they got started. they never stopped all day and did not break one roof tile as I had 12 spare and still got them. Their Electrical inspector came and did an inspection before returning the next morning to do his final inspection before handing to Access Canberra. They assured me at the end of the installation day the system would turn on at first light the next day as it did and produced 18.2 KW on a 13deg overcast / sunny day. More Green Energy sent me an email for the meter replacement which was sent to ACTEW. The completion is now up to ACTEW to replace the Meter so I  have the feed in operational.panels installed 21 x MSquare 315 60 cell and Growatt MIN 5000TL-X at $4000. Research has found this equipment to be value for money with high reliability levels . Highly recommend
Afnan from more green energy has provided me excellent service with all The facts of solar. I had no idea before I spoke to him. I highly recommend their service and products.

MoreGreen Energy is efficient and professional.  Family friend has recommended MoreGreen and Alex has arranged for our solar to be installed within a week of signing the contract.  Amin, Installer is very professional, arrived on time in the morning and have the solar completed by noon.  No need for any tile roof replacement.  Timing is perfect for the colder weather.  Would recommend MoreGreen anytime and ask for Alex.

Worst Customer Service and Technical support I have ever experienced. Not replying to emails or returning calls, if I receive emails they are written in rude and sarcastic manner. The company shows lack of basic technical knowledge and knowledge of the products they are supposed to be supporting. More Green Energy expressed no interest in my struggle with Customer Service and Technical support to resolve a simple configuration issue on my SolarEdge inverter.

After getting called every day to sign and pay for the contract which I did on 03/09/2019. To spending the next 8 months trying to get hold of them. I made numerous phone calls, in which I was lied to every time about the insulation date. Eventually I was told around 4 to 5 months after signing the contract that they didnt install solar in my area. I've spent from January 2020 trying to get my $200 deposit back more lies like "it's in your bank already, I'll call you back in ten, I just need to talk to accounts" etc. I have had the worst experience with these people. DO NOT TRUST  A WORD THEY SAY COMPLETE SCAMMERS. I am going to report them.
reviews.panel_brand: Didnt get it installed just stole my deposit (Other)

reviews.review_description: Value for money is the best compared with other Solar suppliers.Janet was great to deal with, she reviewed my requirements and advised me on what system would suite me. She took care of everything and kept me informed on a regular basis.It was only 4 weeks from purchase to installation.Installation was exceptionally prompt and very good.Janet and her team took care in organising the grid connection.I really didn't have to do anything.

System was installed May 2019, our bills didn't drop by much and then our most recent bill shows there's been no feed since November 2019. We have been trying to get the issue resolved since January 2020 but there is never an answer on the main phone line and emails go unanswered, or they say they will call back but don't. Finally we had an independent assessment and was told that the system wasn't installed properly and appears to be "fake". There are no serial numbers on the panels, the voltage wasn't high enough to support the amount of panels, the cords to the panels were loose, not looped correctly and not raised from the roof, there were bolts from the roofing sheets that were not replaced, and the inverter was faulty. We were also not informed of the requirement of a digital panel, which means we can't get the rebate. Sick of waiting for a response, we threatened them with CEC and Fair Trading complaints and finally got their attention. They replaced the inverter, but the installer said it will blow again because of the set up. They claim that they have the panel serial numbers on file, but have not supplied them as requested, and they said they would request the installer's report yet have not supplied the details.I would not recommend this business to anybody!! Everything about them screams "fraud"

All things delivered in the quoted time frame. Sales people were polite and not pushy. RS 232 never worked so I can't monitor the system. Their tech people haven't come back so I'm guessing they have either forgotten about me or don't know how to fix the problem. The system works fine however even if the toys don't.

***Worst Customer service - Never go with this Solar panel installer ***Will run behind you until you sign contract once you have signed contract they don't care to call you back. When it comes to installation time, they would either change the solar panels saying panels you signed for are not in stock or they don't have electrician available.They never stick to installation date, they changed the date for me just a day before the agreed date.Big NO for this installer's

They quoted a good price, they were responsive at following up with my sales inquiry until they failed to deliver.
